hypothesis: Ordinary LV can choose an entry minimum above the emitted VF, and a later LV invocation can vectorize the entire primary scalar fallback with a separate guard. Certifying each dispatch stage entry, rounded vector count and scalar resume separately makes the execution oracle match actual transformed control flow without changing production scheduling. The shared SSA max(vscale*4,8) in t000052 is one instance of the supported width-or-umax vocabulary, not a special case. Producer/consumer widths and minima can differ. No compiler transformation or math contract changes.
semantics: Reduction recognition is a transactional optional result: a failed scalar candidate can remain in the producer but never changes ParticipationArm or ReductionInsts. Conditional candidates require exactly one nonidentity latch input, an add/fadd defined in that predecessor, an unconditional direct edge to the latch, identity header-PHI values on every bypass, and contribution dominance at the original terminal store point. Every header-PHI use is checked by operand number and incoming edge: only its own accumulator operand and identity bypass operands are allowed. Its update has only its own merge use. Before committing a candidate, every result use must be its own header backedge from the latch or the exact original latch edge of an Exit LCSSA PHI. Thus the first edge from any moved state cannot reach a retained recurrence, predicate, address, contribution or other reduction; no recursive dependence walk or PHI-order assumption is needed. Successful reductions still share one participation arm and are all conditional or all unconditional. Retained PHIs/starts/backedges, merges, arithmetic, flags and branches stay at their original sites and iteration order. Final producer exports retain d2 exact value/edge forwarding and dominance checks, including P=0 and a final inactive iteration. No last-participant substitute, speculative arithmetic, freeze or input reread is introduced. Acyclic branch-only CFG and finite/representable full-trip storage proofs, effect/call/load whitelist, strictfp/constrained-FP rejection, pointer-index ceilings, LCSSA and metadata contracts remain. The counter stores at old P and increments exactly once on the common terminal edge, retaining old P on every bypass; 0<=P<=N<=M bounds all stores and consumer reads. Ordered unconstrained FP clones original update operands/flags and executes exactly the original participating additions; P=0 returns the exact start without adding an identity. Explicit fission FP reordering is tested separately and adds no fast-math/errno assumptions. Chunk scheduling retains d2 canonical single-block, unconditional, zero-start/unit-step, equality-exit restrictions and now explicitly also excludes retained state. All compiler IR mutation still follows every rejection point. Executable verification requests actual original/transformed IR and independent C formulas for three new state/CFG/export interactions, eleven exact historical feedback/export fixtures whose whole-loop outcomes change, and the historical cross-reduction fixture, alongside every inherited matrix. Probes check N/P, all bypasses, vector/tail/empty/zero-entry/final-inactive paths before fixed-vscale host execution; uninstrumented original scalable output is separately RVV machine-verified. Revision t000049 changes no recognition, operand/edge closure or IR schedule. Default dispatch checks now bind the producer XOR and consumer add to their actual scratch values and observable results, account for every emitted loop, and check role metadata and original DILocation on each latch. Source-located selection certificates require exactly four original targets at dispatch.c:10/20/30/50:5 and independently read both stage VFs rather than applying VPlan forced widths to scalar stages. Exact original dispatch definitions are separately renamed/compiled as references. The C oracle computes wrapping uint32 sum and XOR independently, compares the original result/canaries to that formula and the transformed results to the original, including permitted aliased output. Probe counts use actual producer/consumer widths with no VPlan-tail instrumentation on early stages; per-configuration execution names/counters must match all generated early sum/XOR variants. The original VPlan stage and repeated-LV tail certificates remain unchanged and now run on an explicit isolated dispatch matrix under both policies. The ordered overlap and nested compact matrix remain. Serial/nested predicate select mutations remain; affine uses an applicable icmp eq-to-ne mutation and each must fail its intended export-control certificate after construction. New dispatch mutations check actual scratch, output, role, provenance and source-location obligations. The dispatch stage certificate accounts separately for any ordinary vector remainder emitted by follow-up hints, derives its width from its actual scratch access, and retains independent entry/lane counters alongside the four primary scalar/vector counters. Repeated-LV scalar VF-1 revisit remarks are permitted without overwriting the first observed primary stage width; all actual loops still require the original attached role and source location. Revision t000052 removes the manually enumerated ExportFn reference declarations from the C template. Each of the four full-trip export families and the chunk family emits declarations from its actual references mapping before compiling the reference object. A fixture-scoped ABI check requires void, six default-space pointer parameters, two i64 parameters and double, matching ExportFn; the regression independently checks the C typedef and its const/element types. Source and reference definition sets must match the mapping exactly, every mapped reference must have one definition, and its entire definition must equal the original with only mapped global symbols renamed. Missing/duplicate/swapped symbols, wrong ABI, changed bodies and compact-CFG substitution for state-CFG are rejected. The production export_variant emitter shares the actual mapped reference with each C row, uses the same transformed symbol in its definition and declaration, preserves all mode/lane values, and checks the variant ABI before reserving names. The focused test isolates this generator with original fixture bodies; it does not claim transformed-path execution. Mandatory linked execution of the actual transformed IR against those exact originals and independent formulas remains the harness acceptance obligation. Revision t000053 adds dispatch_entry_certificates for the scalar-remainder default sum/XOR stages and full-trip ordered overlap. It resolves a threshold in whole-function SSA (including CSE across stages), but independently proves each stage guard and actual branch destinations. Supported thresholds are vscale*actualVF (shl or mul) or unsigned max of that width and one positive u32 constant, in either operand order. It accepts ult N,T / ugt T,N with scalar on true and uge N,T / ule T,N with vector on true. The certificate binds the vector zero-based induction, VF step, urem/sub vector-rounded count, exact equality exit and empty-remainder branch to a scalar PHI that resumes at zero on fallback or at the rounded index after vectors. An optional ordinary vector loop is certified against N minus that primary resume, with its own threshold and width, scratch base plus local index and next scalar resume. It checks bounded/nonzero original entry, predecessor edges, scalar unit induction and N exit; only one PHI-only LCSSA exit forwarding block is allowed. The C oracle takes four independently certified absolute minima in addition to emitted widths. Primary entries are N/VF only when the certified minimum is met; the remainder includes the entire N on primary fallback. Ordinary entries use that remainder and their own minimum; residual scalar entries and exact lane conservation remain mandatory. Expectations never read probes. Width-only zero defaults preserve every inherited VPlan row. The default integer sum/XOR and ordered overlap execute all N=0..66 plus inherited 257/1023/1024/1025 under both policies and LV1/LV2 at vscales 1/2/4/8/32, preserving originals, independent integer formulas, aliases, canaries, guarded inputs and FP comparisons. Explicit isolated VPlan dispatch, EVL codegen-only contracts and every state/CFG/export/chunk certificate remain intact.

New mixed interactions reserve [65 x i32], [65 x double], [65 x float]: 260+4 ABI padding+520+260=1044 bytes. Four reductions share three contributions.
